$comment: Named looks the studio can render a topic in. A style only ever supplies the `look` clause. The framing-and-plate clause is appended to every prompt by app/studioPrompt.js and is deliberately not editable here, because carving finds the background by flooding inward from the border: a style that introduced scenery, a gradient or a drop shadow would produce art that cannot be carved. Add a style by adding an entry; `house` is the one the existing 83 assets were generated in.

styles.label: House style
styles.blurb: What the existing 83 assets were generated in. Start here unless you want a deliberate departure.
styles.look: Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, bright friendly colors.

styles.label: Watercolour
styles.blurb: Softer and more delicate. Good for calm, dreamy things; weaker outlines make for a fussier carve.
styles.look: Soft watercolour storybook illustration, visible paper texture, gentle washes of colour that bleed slightly, delicate ink linework.

styles.label: Felt and stitch
styles.blurb: Handmade toy look. Reads as something you could actually sew, which suits textiles and soft furniture.
styles.look: Made of craft felt and stitched fabric, visible blanket-stitch seams, slightly fuzzy edges, flat matte colours, handmade toy look.

styles.label: Claymation
styles.blurb: Chunky and tactile, with real weight. Strong silhouettes, so it carves cleanly.
styles.look: Claymation stop-motion look, softly moulded plasticine forms with visible thumbprints, chunky and tactile, matte surface.

styles.label: Paper cut
styles.blurb: Layered flat shapes with crisp edges. The cleanest carve of any style here.
styles.look: Layered paper-cut collage, flat shapes with crisp scissor-cut edges, subtle paper grain, gentle separation between layers.

styles.label: Wax crayon
styles.blurb: Scribbly and childlike, as if Abbie drew it herself. Loose edges make the carve rough on purpose.
styles.look: Bright wax crayon drawing, waxy uneven strokes, colour scribbled slightly outside the lines, energetic and childlike.

styles.label: Stained glass
styles.blurb: Bold leading and luminous colour. Dramatic, and the heavy black outlines carve very well.
styles.look: Stained-glass look, bold black leading dividing panes of luminous saturated colour, flat and graphic.

styles.label: Gingerbread
styles.blurb: Everything as if baked and iced. Silly and very popular with six-year-olds.
styles.look: Made of baked gingerbread with piped white royal icing details and candy buttons, warm brown dough, thick clean dark outlines.
